Package org.osgi.impl.service.dmt.dispatcher

Class Segment<P>

java.lang.Object
org.osgi.impl.service.dmt.dispatcher.Segment<P>
public class Segment<P> extends Object
A Segment represents one node in the dmtree. Segments can have a Plugin assigned or not. Segments with an assigned Plugins are the roots of the subtree that the plugin is responsible for. Segments without an assigned plugin just ensure that the whole tree is browsable and are created/removed as needed when plugins are mapped/unmapped. Each Segment knows its parent and children.
